text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Where there's a will, there's a 
way—nothing is impossible!" How was that, 
Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"A miraculous, grand comeback at the 
Takarazuka Kinen! I did it! I really did 
itttt!"
choice_data_list: The fans must be thrilled, huh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, hearing the cheers from the stands 
made me so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, we have no choice but to 
blaze right through summer too. So, let's 
do this thing for the first time in a 
while!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What will it be? Fortune-telling time! 
Let's leave our next race entirely up to 
chance!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm not being reckless this time, okay? 
Last time I left it to luck, but today I 
have my reasons.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san, please draw a 
fortune slip. Ready, go!
Target race changed to the Hakodate Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The Hakodate Kinen! The million-dollar 
night view is waiting for us—!
Target race changed to the Kokura Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The Kokura Kinen! A heated battle in 
summer Kyushu! Let us make our way to the 
land where the fire god dwells."

The target race has been set to the 
Sapporo Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The Sapporo Kinen! The Snow Festival 
isn't on since it's summer, but let's win 
and have our own Good Fortune Festival!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That settles our summer plans, then. By 
the way, I didn't actually just rely on 
luck this time, you know?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It means we'll take on whatever fate 
throws at us! Let's join forces and make 
this a happy summer!
